title: Dynamic modelling predicts lactate and IL-1beta as interventional targets in metabolic-inflammation-clock regulatory loop in glioma.
authors: Sharma, Shalini; Gowda, Pruthvi; Lathoria, Kirti; Mitra, Mithun K; Sen, Ellora
journal: Integrative biology : quantitative biosciences from nano to macro
one_liner_zh: 该文构建胶质瘤代谢-炎症-昼夜节律调控回路的数学模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: In an attempt to understand the role of dysregulated circadian rhythm in glioma, our recent findings highlighted the existence of a feed-forward loop between tumour metabolite lactate, pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-1beta and circadian CLOCK. To further elucidate the implication of this complex interplay, we developed a mathematical model that quantitatively describes this lactate dehydrogenase A (LDHA)-IL-1beta-CLOCK/BMAL1 circuit and predicts potential therapeutic targets. The model was calibrated on quantitative western blotting data in two glioma cell lines in response to either lactate inhibition or IL-1beta stimulation. The calibrated model described the experimental data well and most of the parameters were identifiable, thus the model was predictive. Sensitivity analysis identified IL-1beta and LDHA as potential intervention points. Mathematical models described here can be useful to understand the complex interrelationship between metabolism, inflammation and circadian rhythm, and in designing effective therapeutic strategies. Our findings underscore the importance of including the circadian clock when developing pharmacological approaches that target aberrant tumour metabolism and inflammation. Insight box  The complex interplay of metabolism-inflammation-circadian rhythm in tumours is not well understood. Our recent findings provided evidence of a feed-forward loop between tumour metabolite lactate, pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-1beta and circadian CLOCK/BMAL1 in glioma. To elucidate the implication of this complex interplay, we developed a mathematical model that quantitatively describes this LDHA-IL-1beta-CLOCK/BMAL1 circuit and integrates experimental data to predict potential therapeutic targets. The study employed a multi-start optimization strategy and profile likelihood estimations for parameter estimation and assessing identifiability. The simulations are in reasonable agreement with the experimental data. Sensitivity analysis found LDHA and IL-1beta as potential therapeutic points. Mathematical models described here can provide insights to understand the complex interrelationship between metabolism, inflammation and circadian rhythm, and in identifying effective therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 为了理解昼夜节律失调在胶质瘤中的作用，我们近期的发现强调了肿瘤代谢物乳酸、促炎细胞因子IL-1β与昼夜节律CLOCK之间存在前馈环路。为进一步阐明这一复杂相互作用的含义，我们开发了一个数学模型，定量描述了乳酸脱氢酶A (LDHA)-IL-1β-CLOCK/BMAL1回路，并预测潜在的治疗靶点。该模型基于两种胶质瘤细胞系中对乳酸抑制或IL-1β刺激响应的定量western blotting数据进行了校准。校准后的模型能很好地描述实验数据，且大多数参数可辨识，因此模型具有预测性。敏感性分析确定了IL-1β和LDHA为潜在干预点。本文描述的数学模型有助于理解代谢、炎症与昼夜节律之间的复杂相互关系，并有助于设计有效的治疗策略。我们的发现强调了在开发针对异常肿瘤代谢和炎症的药理学方法时，纳入昼夜节律钟的重要性。要点框 肿瘤中代谢-炎症-昼夜节律的复杂相互作用尚未被充分理解。我们近期的发现提供了胶质瘤中肿瘤代谢物乳酸、促炎细胞因子IL-1β与昼夜节律CLOCK/BMAL1之间存在前馈环路的证据。为阐明这一复杂相互作用的含义，我们开发了一个数学模型，定量描述了LDHA-IL-1β-CLOCK/BMAL1回路，并整合实验数据以预测潜在治疗靶点。该研究采用了多起点优化策略和轮廓似然估计进行参数估计和可辨识性评估。模拟结果与实验数据基本一致。敏感性分析发现LDHA和IL-1β为潜在治疗点。本文描述的数学模型可为理解代谢、炎症与昼夜节律之间的复杂相互关系及识别有效治疗靶点提供见解。
